name: cpu_l1_mmu_demo
description:
Phase 1.5 Wave 2: CPU + MMU + L1 (declared) + Memory structural topology. Runner builds CPU+MMU+Memory via C++ manually (enable_mmu=true, sv32). L1CachePlugin is declared for topology completeness but NOT instantiated in the runner — instantiation deferred to Wave 3 cache-dse-sweep. See openspec/changes/soc-cpu-l1-mmu-demo/ for full spec.

mmu-memory-interface: mmu.memory_interface='picolibc_host_memory' (P1#3 mmu-paddr-consume §6.1) 声明 PTW 读真实内存路径；runner 在 tests/soc/test_cpu_l1_mmu_demo.cpp C++ 端透传 PicolibcHostMemory* 给 RiscvMMUPlugin（§6.2 重述 scope：JSON 声明式 + CpuFactory::register_early_plugins 透传, 见 Oracle review C7）。
